title: ForecastOutput
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining the predictive engine's final forecast output, including risk levels, stability projections, wellbeing impacts, and recommended focus areas.

forecastId.description: Unique identifier for this forecast output.

inputId.description: Identifier of the prediction-input.json or risk-scan.json that generated this forecast.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the forecast was generated.

riskScore.description: Normalized risk score representing likelihood of harm or instability.

riskFactors.description: List of contributing factors influencing the risk score.

stabilityProjection.description: Projection of system or scenario stability over time.
